title: Title Case Words
description:
Write a function `title_case_words(sentence)` that capitalizes the first letter of each word in a string, leaving other letters unchanged.
Return an empty string if the input is empty.

hidden_tests.kind: a string with multiple consecutive spaces

hints: String transformation often involves decomposing into words, processing, and recombining.
Pay attention to how spaces are preserved between words.
Using split() without arguments collapses multiple consecutive spaces into a single space.
Split by ' ' or iterate through characters while capitalizing letters immediately preceded by whitespace.
